scenes.label: A station platform just before the last train. One friend is leaving; the other has brought a forgotten key.
scenes.point: Ask someone to stay without asking them to give up their plans.

ko.label: 막차 직전의 승강장. 떠나는 친구에게 두고 간 열쇠를 건넨다.
ko.point: 상대의 계획을 꺾지 않으면서 조금 더 머물러 달라고 해보세요.

en.label: A station platform just before the last train. One friend is leaving; the other has brought a forgotten key.
en.point: Ask someone to stay without asking them to give up their plans.

lines.t: You left this on the kitchen table.
My key. I thought I had everything.
I could post it tomorrow.
Then why did you run all the way here?
I wanted to know you got on the right train.
There is only one train, Maya.
I know. I had a better sentence on the way.
You still have a minute.
Call me when the new place starts to feel like home.
I will. And I am keeping the key.

scenes.label: Two flatmates pack a jacket for a job interview. There is something hidden in its pocket.
scenes.point: Offer help while respecting the other person’s pride.

ko.label: 면접용 재킷을 빌려주는 두 룸메이트. 주머니에 무언가 들어 있다.

en.label: Two flatmates pack a jacket for a job interview. There is something hidden in its pocket.
en.point: Offer help while respecting the other person’s pride.

lines.t: The sleeves are a little long.
Fold them once. Nobody will notice.
There is cash in the pocket.
Old jacket. Things get lost in it.
Exactly enough for a return ticket?
A very organised jacket.
I said I could manage.
And I said you could borrow it. All of it.
I will bring it back tomorrow.
Keep it until they give you the job.

scenes.label: A small gallery is closing. A visitor will not leave a painting.
scenes.point: Let curiosity change an ordinary rule.

ko.label: 문을 닫는 작은 갤러리. 관람객이 그림 앞을 떠나지 못한다.
ko.point: 호기심 때문에 평소의 규칙이 달라지는 순간을 찾아보세요.

en.label: A small gallery is closing. A visitor will not leave a painting.
en.point: Let curiosity change an ordinary rule.

lines.t: We close in five minutes.
You said that five minutes ago.
I was hoping you had a watch.
My mother used to paint windows like that.
Is that why you have been standing here?
Her windows always had someone coming home.
This one is empty.
Maybe they are just late.
I need to turn the lights off in the other room.
Then I have five more minutes.

scenes.label: Two filmmakers discover that their favourite take was recorded without sound.
scenes.point: Admit a mistake, then make a practical offer.

ko.label: 두 영화 제작자가 가장 좋아한 테이크에 소리가 없다는 걸 알게 된다.
ko.point: 실수를 인정한 뒤 실제로 할 수 있는 제안을 해보세요.

en.label: Two filmmakers discover that their favourite take was recorded without sound.
en.point: Admit a mistake, then make a practical offer.

lines.t: Play it from the beginning.
I have. Three times.
Why is it quiet?
I checked the camera. I did not check the microphone.
That was the take.
I know.
We cannot get that light tomorrow.
We have twelve minutes of it left today.
You think we can do it again?
I think I owe you a reason to try.

scenes.label: A café owner has kept a table for an old friend who rarely visits.
scenes.point: Ask for connection through an everyday task.

ko.label: 카페 주인이 좀처럼 오지 않는 옛 친구를 위해 자리를 남겨둔다.
ko.point: 일상적인 부탁 속에 다시 가까워지고 싶은 마음을 담아보세요.

en.label: A café owner has kept a table for an old friend who rarely visits.
en.point: Ask for connection through an everyday task.

lines.t: Is this seat taken?
It has been waiting for someone.
I can find another table.
You could also sit down.
I was not sure you would want me here.
I bought the tea you like. It expires on Friday.
That sounds like a deadline.
It is a very small box.
Then we should probably start today.
I will get a second cup.

scenes.label: Siblings clear a family home. One unlabelled box remains.
scenes.point: Negotiate what to keep without deciding for the other person.

ko.label: 가족의 집을 정리하는 남매. 이름 없는 상자 하나가 남아 있다.
ko.point: 상대를 대신해 결정하지 않으면서 무엇을 남길지 이야기해보세요.

en.label: Siblings clear a family home. One unlabelled box remains.
en.point: Negotiate what to keep without deciding for the other person.

lines.t: What is in the last box?
Things nobody wanted to label.
That means you have already looked.
There is a photo of us in the garden.
Keep it.
You say that about everything.
It is easier than saying I want it.
We can make a copy.
A copy will not have the fold in the middle.
Then you keep this one. I remember the fold.

scenes.label: Minutes before a first performance, one actor considers leaving.
scenes.point: Help a partner take one small action instead of promising success.

ko.label: 첫 공연 직전, 한 배우가 떠날 생각을 한다.
ko.point: 성공을 장담하기보다 상대가 작은 행동 하나를 하도록 도와보세요.

en.label: Minutes before a first performance, one actor considers leaving.
en.point: Help a partner take one small action instead of promising success.

lines.t: I cannot remember the first line.
You said it in the lift.
That was before there were people outside.
Then say it to me.
What if nothing comes out?
I will still be standing here.
You make it sound very simple.
It is one line. We can worry about the second after that.
Will you look at me when I come on?
I was going to ask you the same thing.

scenes.label: Two friends meet outside a cinema after one has cancelled several times.
scenes.point: Make a clear boundary while leaving room for repair.

ko.label: 몇 번이나 약속을 취소했던 친구가 영화관 앞에 나타난다.
ko.point: 관계를 회복할 여지를 남기면서 분명한 기준을 말해보세요.

en.label: Two friends meet outside a cinema after one has cancelled several times.
en.point: Make a clear boundary while leaving room for repair.

lines.t: You are actually here.
I deserve that.
The film started ten minutes ago.
We could catch the next one.
I do not want another next one.
Then tell me what would help.
A message before I leave home. Even a bad one.
I can do that.
And dinner. I skipped dinner for this.
There is a place across the road. We can go now.

scenes.label: An artist asks a friend to open a letter from an exhibition jury.
scenes.point: Separate the fear of an answer from the desire to know it.

ko.label: 전시 심사 결과를 받은 예술가가 친구에게 편지를 열어 달라고 한다.
ko.point: 답이 두려운 마음과 알고 싶은 마음을 구별해보세요.

en.label: An artist asks a friend to open a letter from an exhibition jury.
en.point: Separate the fear of an answer from the desire to know it.

lines.t: Will you open it?
You put your name on the application.
That version of me was very confident.
This version made the same work.
If it is a no, do not make that face.
Which face?
The one that says you knew it would be.
I do not know. That is why the envelope is interesting.
All right. Open it while I am looking.
Come closer. We can read it together.

scenes.label: A new colleague arrives early to cover a tired worker’s shift.
scenes.point: Let concern emerge through practical details.

ko.label: 지친 동료를 대신하려 새 직원이 일찍 출근한다.
ko.point: 구체적인 일 이야기를 통해 걱정하는 마음이 드러나게 해보세요.

en.label: A new colleague arrives early to cover a tired worker’s shift.
en.point: Let concern emerge through practical details.

lines.t: You are an hour early.
The bus was unusually helpful.
There is another one every ten minutes.
I thought you might want to go home.
I said I was fine.
You have made the same cup of coffee twice.
The first one went cold.
So did the second. Give me the keys.
The back door sticks when it rains.
Show me once. Then go get some sleep.
